notes.title: Nov. 22 Open Beta Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Onboarding[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Some new level-up rewards have been added. If you are already past those levels, any one-time unlocks will be given to you when you next log in. The studded pants can be bought separately from Gibby (as with any other level-up clothing items, studded or not).
[/list]
[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The [b]central extraction[/b] event can now be contested from a wider radius reaching into the surrounding roads and corridor so that you don’t have to enter the room in order to contest it.
	[*]The fuel tanks for the [b]central extraction[/b] event will now be empty if the event isn’t on.
	[*]The [b]EMP[/b] event has had a variety of changes made to it:
[list]
	[*]EMP effects now [i]open[/i] doors instead of closing them, even if the door in question was locked (in which case it also removes the power cost). This effect has also been changed on EMP grenades.
[list]
	[*]It does not unlock keycard doors.
[/list]
[list]
	[*]The HUD effect for when you are affected by an EMP has been made a bit more intense to make it more obvious.
	[*]The amount of damage the EMP receives to its ‘body’ has been doubled.
	[*]The EMP now receives triple damage from sniper rifles.
	[*]The health of the EMP device has been slightly lowered.
	[*]If the EMP is destroyed, it now immediately re-enables any shields it had disabled (as opposed to waiting for the last ‘pulse’ to expire).
[/list]
	[*]You now need to hold Tab in order to eject from the gorlizard.
	[*]The sounds from the player controlled gorlizard’s footsteps should now be louder.
	[*][b]Reactor Meltdown has been given a face lift.[/b]
	[*]The forest power orbs have received some new visuals.
	[*]Solo burrowers (as in, not part of the burrower horde event) should now be a bit more common.
[/list]
[h2]Match Rules[/h2]
[list]
	[*]How [b]shops [/b]populate their weapons has been completely reworked.
[list]
	[*]The same weapon will no longer be able to appear in multiple shops.
	[*]The same shop will no longer be able to have two weapons of the same type.
	[*]There is now a guarantee that all weapon types will be represented in shops around the map.
[/list]
	[*]The armory shop will no longer be able to sell resurrectors.
	[*]The infirmary shop will no longer sell offensive grenades but has a chance of selling resurrectors.
[/list]
[h2]Weapons & Consumables[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Shotguns and plasma rifles have had ammo counters added to the back of the gun so you can more quickly tell how much ammo is left in the magazine (in particular while aiming down sights).
	[*]More shotgun, plasma rifle, and beam glove modules have received bespoke models.
	[*]More weapon paint jobs have been tweaked to look a bit better.
	[*]The audio for energy bomber explosions has been reworked.
	[*]Pulse bombs can now knock you off ladders.
[/list]
[h2]Movement[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The camera movement from sprinting should now be lessened for weapons that don’t provide a sprint speed bonus.
[/list]
[h2]Perks & Abilities[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The speed increase from [b]Hail Rush[/b] is now 20% (up from 15%).
	[*][b]Point-Blank Transfer[/b] now heals for 30% of damage done (up from 25%).
	[*][b]Marksman's Patience[/b] now kicks in after 1.5 seconds in ADS (down from 2 seconds) and increases damage by 25% (up from 15%).
	[*][b]Efficient Metabolism[/b] now doubles the duration of Rejuvenation Fruits (up from 50%).
	[*][b]Cheat Death[/b] now kicks in regardless of your health value (as opposed to only triggering if you had over 20 health). (Well, technically, you need to have 1 or more health remaining.)
	[*]The [b]Heat Shields [/b]perk no longer reduces shield damage from energy attacks but instead reduces damage your shields take from physical attacks by 20% (up from 15%). Having it affect energy damage made the damage type potentially counter-intuitive since it’s the type that [i]should[/i] be strong against shields.
	[*][b]Shield Charger[/b] now repairs shields for 25% of damage dealt (up from 20%).
	[*][b]Desperation[/b] now scales beam glove damage up to 50% (up from 30%).
	[*]The chance of spores spreading for each tick of damage they do with the [b]Contagion[/b] perk is now 20% (up from 10%).
	[*][b]Ammo Specialist[/b] now lets you carry an additional 100 energy and light ammo (up from 50) and 50 extra heavy ammo (up from 25). Instead of the ammo cost from shops being reduced by 50%, ammo is now free in shops when you use this perk.
	[*][b]Med Sharing[/b] now applies med kits and shield repairers 25% faster (up from 20%).
	[*]The highlight from [b]Bioscan Tracker[/b] now lasts for 2 minutes (up from 1 minute).
	[*][b]Improvising Artisan[/b] now causes the victim to drop 30 light and energy ammo (up from 20) and 20 heavy ammo (up from 10). It now also always drops 5 extra Power on a melee kill.
	[*][b]One With Nature[/b] now reduces damage from wildlife by 50% (up from 20%).
	[*]Receiving healing from [b]Toxic Transfusion[/b] now makes you glow, to make it clearer to other players that you are healing.
	[*][b]Threat Scanner: EMP[/b] now has a 90-second cooldown (up from 60).
	[*][b]Thundercall: Rapid[/b] now has a 16-second cooldown (down from 20).
	[*]Lightning strikes from both [b]Thundercall [/b]abilities now detonate half a second faster.
	[*][b]Scale Shield: Tank now also removes all debuffs when it triggers.[/b]
	[*][b]Rocket Jump has received some audio uplifts.[/b]
	[*]The [b]Bunker Dome[/b] abilities have received some audio.
[/list]
[h2]Environment[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The main corridor running through the vaults has received a complete visual overhaul. Its appearance and colors should now be more consistent around the vaults so it sticks out better, and it’s been given some flowing lines to guide you around the vaults more clearly, along with exit signs on the floor where relevant.
	[*]The main corridor running through the reactor has had its curved windows swapped out for flat ones so that you can’t contest Biocore stabilizations in the reactor from the corridor.
	[*]The deathbringer can now drive through the tunnel under Thermal Transfer (when it’s not collapsed).
[/list]
[h2]Lobby[/h2]
[list]
	[*]A [b]THUNDERDOME[/b] has been added to the lobby. This is a PvP arena where players can fight each other just for the fun of it or while waiting for a match to start.
[list]
	[*]The Thunderdome takes place on a platform hanging over the ravine outside the home shade.
	[*]It is a free-for-all PvP arena where you can simply fight other players or, if no other players are present, some bots.
	[*]You can reach the Thunderdome via a teleporter located on the platform overlooking the ravine. This will send you to the preparation area, where you can equip weapons and shields before launching yourself into the Thunderdome itself to join in on the carnage.
	[*]You will also be automatically sent to the staging area when you begin matchmaking (unless you were busy doing something else). While waiting for the queue to pop, join in with some warm-up fights!
	[*]Each kill in the Thunderdome rewards you with a little bit of XP. Reaching longer kill streaks will reward you with bonus XP. A kill also fully restores your health (but not your shields).
	[*]If you die in the Thunderdome (or fall off it), don’t worry! You will just be sent back to the staging area and you’re free to launch straight back into the action and get your revenge. We even auto-reload your weapons for you.
	[*]Your highest kill streak and total kills is tracked under your player stats.
[/list]
	[*]The addition of the Thunderdome has resulted in a few tweaks to the layout of the lobby around the ravine. Time trials that made use of the now missing platform have been slightly adjusted (and will now be ever so slightly shorter, to avoid that previous records are unbeatable without having to wipe any times).
	[*]The target dummies in the firing range have been reworked. They’ve been given a visual uplift, should now make it clearer which shield is being used, and they play an animation when they would’ve died (if they were a player).
	[*]You will now spawn into duels with weapon 1 equipped.
	[*]The Halloween decorations have been removed.
	[*]The 6th [i]action figure[/i] can once again be accessed the intended way.
	[*]…Something else might also have appeared somewhere in the lobby.
[/list]
[h2]Customization[/h2]
[list]
	[*]You can once again toggle on nudity in the character customizer.
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Various cosmetic item icons have been updated.
	[*]Reward and level-up pop-ups have been completely reworked. When you level up, you will now see upcoming rewards.
	[*]The personal best time trial times in the profile should now show milliseconds.
	[*]The HUD should now fade out at the end of a match to not overlap with the Victory/Defeat display.
	[*]Objective update messages have been made a bit less obtrusive.
	[*]News pop-ups should now only appear once even if you restart the game.
	[*]Remaining health should no longer be able to round down to 0.
	[*]The character customizer should now make it more clear when you’re trying to use up more dyes than you have.
	[*]The UI to join a creator clan has been reworked.

[/list]
[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list]
	[*]A new audio system has been implemented to block out [b]audio [/b]from the underground to above ground and vice versa. There are still some kinks to work out for when you are around entrances/exits, but it should now be much easier to tell if sounds come from someone near you, or if they are actually on the surface above or underground below. 
	[*]Biocore contest barriers should be visible so you can see where you need to go in order to contest (or stop contesting) a stabilizing Biocore. The barrier will be red if the Biocore is currently being contested.
	[*]More performance improvements have been made.
	[*]Lowered the volume of the match intro video of the truck arriving.
	[*]Audio reverb has been put back in, but in a more performant fashion.
	[*]Error messages to go along with failing to connect to the game should now be a bit more informative.
	[*]You can now rebind the push to talk button.
	[*]The keybind to summon quad vehicles (if you’ve unlocked the team upgrade) can now be rebound.
	[*]Players should now have a little bit more time to adjust their loadout at the start of a game.
	[*]The layout of players and UI elements in the intro truck have been redistributed to allow for larger team sizes. We’re not yet [i]using[/i] larger team sizes but dun dun dunnn.
	[*]Loot beams have received a bit of low to be more obvious.
	[*]Using the ‘Join Game’ feature in Steam will now load you into that friend’s lobby (if they are in one and it has room).
	[*]Defender drone machine guns have been given their own audio.
	[*]Lockers should now be a bit quieter.
	[*]Some more dialogue lines have been added.
	[*]Victory and defeat music should now start playing immediately at the end of the match, and not wait until the winners have been displayed.
	[*]Avatar images have been given names that aren’t just numbers.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]The weapon HUD should no longer reappear in the lobby if you change between weapons in an area where you can’t fire them.
	[*]Fixed an issue where the deathbringer appeared in low poly format just before it’s ready.
	[*]Fixed various issues with clipping clothing and clothing that deformed strangely during certain animations.
	[*]Deathbringer weapons should no longer be invulnerable to shots that hit their ‘health bars’.
	[*]If you duel a player in your party, their name plate should be hidden while in the arena.
	[*]Fixed an issue where forest power orbs looked intact if someone else had destroyed them while you were far away.
	[*]Fixed an issue where team upgrade stations could display as offline even when they weren’t.
	[*]Another attempt at fixing the crackling audio issue that can sometimes occur on certain CPUs has been made. Here’s hoping this one is more reliable and doesn’t just [i]lessen [/i]the issue.
	[*]Fixed various typos across the game.
	[*]Fixed an issue where the objective icon could occasionally point at the wrong location after reconnecting to a match.
	[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes the map and loadout wouldn’t appear on the respawn screen.
	[*]A variety of issues with tabbing or clicking out from the text chat prompt have been fixed.
	[*]Dropped items should no longer fall through the roof of the airstrike tower.
	[*]Fixed a lot of issues with NPCs clipping into terrain or floors.
	[*]More janky collision has been de-jankified.
	[*]A variety of walls that were just slightly too tall to climb have been fixed so that they can be consistently climbed and not leave you falling right as you peeked over the edge.
	[*]The hide and seek pistol now has audio.
	[*]Deathbringer weapons now have tracers.
	[*]Bots should no longer be able to shoot while stealing a Biocore.
	[*]The ‘Death Won’t Do Us Part’ achievement should now work.
	[*]Radial menus should no longer break if you cancel them.
	[*]Fixed some text alignment issues in the codex.
	[*]Pressing ‘Escape’ on the matchmaking screen to close it should now also unready you.
	[*]Fixed various double doors that the player controlled gorlizard could not crouch through (it should be able to crouch through all double door frames).
	[*]Fixed various crashes.
	[*]Missions to do healing should now update even when you repair shields.
	[*]You should no longer get a scoreboard and mission update after doing the tutorial.
	[*]A lot of fixes have been done to sort out weird hand slides and arm bending for third person weapon animations.
	[*]If you pick up a custom weapon from a player who has left the match, they should no longer be invisible.
	[*]Opponents in the duel arena should now block you.
	[*]Made it so Force Shields can be seen from further away.
	[*]Force Shield should no longer become invisible to you if you use a sniper scope to look over it.
	[*]Custom weapon tooltips should now properly show who made them.
	[*]Far-away terrain and buildings should now have proper collision so that effects like cluster bombs can detonate against them.
	[*]Sticky grenades should no longer become invisible when attached to something from point blank range.
	[*]You should once again be getting score for Biocores held or in the process of securing when a match times out.
	[*]The douse UI should no longer disappear when you fire a surge plasma rifle.
	[*]Fixed an issue where a repeated ‘landing’ sound could be heard when spectating players.
	[*]Fixed an issue where the weapon animation could go a bit weird if you interrupted a revive.
	[*]Pick-ups in the reactor control room should no longer be floating off desks or clipping into walls.
	[*]Matchmaking music should now stop playing if matchmaking failed for some reason.
	[*]Fixed various issues where the game thought you were underground when you weren’t (some sneaky volumes protruding through the floor in some places around the map), which would result in some odd behaviours for NPCs and mission markers.
	[*]Picking up a second hyper cannon should now stack the ammo (up to its maximum) instead of overwriting whatever number of rounds you had with the number from the new weapon.
	[*]Fixed a few issues with the spoiler appearing incorrect when using vehicle skins.
	[*]Getting downed or killed by the Shield Surge perk should now show an icon in the kill feed.
	[*]You should no longer be locked in place if you get killed while initiating a leap attack with the gorlizard.
	[*]The gorlizard should no longer be able to perform leap slides.
	[*]You should no longer be stuck in crouch while carrying a Biocore and crouching on steep slopes.
	[*]The amount of XP you get based on match duration broke in a previous build (so you got a lot less than you should have), but has now been put back to the intended value.
	[*]You can no longer steal Biocores through the bottom door panel in the base vehicles. I.e., you can no longer sit hidden inside the vehicle while stealing the Biocore.
	[*]You can no longer swap to a forward camp that is overlapped by the deathbringer, to stop it clashing with the car that spawns in.
[/list]

notes.title: Nov. 8 Open Beta Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Onboarding[/h2]
[list]
	[*]You are now able to matchmake even if you have pending onboarding missions to do in the lobby.
[/list]
[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Time delayed events will now have shorter activation delay for matches with a max duration less than 30 minutes.
	[*]The player controlled [b]gorlizard[/b] no longer benefits from the Cheat Death perk.
	[*]Other players should now hear a loud roar when someone takes control of the [b]gorlizard[/b].
[/list]
[h2]Match Rules[/h2]
[list]
	[*]For this beta weekend (and possibly intermittently going forwards), there is a chance that a match will be in a [b]Biocore Hyperdrive[/b] state. These matches are played with a single Biocore, with a 20-minute maximum match time, and with a shorter Biocore stabilization time.
[/list]
[h2]Weapons & Consumables[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The damage bonuses from [b]semi-automatic battle rifle triggers[/b] have been reduced.
[list]
	[*][b]Semi - Standard[/b] now has a damage bonus of 38% (down from 43%).
	[*][b]Semi - Resetter[/b] now has a damage bonus of 28% (down from 33%).
	[*][b]Semi - Blast Charger[/b] now has a damage bonus of 50% (down from 58%).
	[*][b]Semi - Corruptor[/b] now has a damage bonus of 73% (down from 88%).
[/list]
	[*]The base damage of [b]heavy battle rifle ammo[/b] has been increased to 20.72 damage (up from 19.98).
	[*]The [b]Fall-Off[/b] stat for [b]battle rifles[/b] has been made less impactful on a module’s score. This means that modules with this stat have either had their stat or their cost adjusted.
[list]
	[*]The [b]Light - Round Nose[/b] ammo now has a -22% Fall-Off (down from -15%).
	[*]The [b]Light - Stabilizer[/b] ammo now has a +3.3% Fall-Off (up from +3%).
	[*]The [b]Auto - Rapid[/b] trigger now has a -8% Fall-Off (down from 0%).
	[*]The [b]Auto - Ultra Rapid[/b] trigger now has a -11% Fall-Off (down from 0%).
	[*]The [b]Auto - Rapid Stabilizer[/b] trigger now has a -5% Fall-Off (down from 0%).
	[*]The [b]Medium - Gyro-Bore[/b] barrel now has a +8% Fall-Off.
[/list]
	[*]Similar to the Fall-Off changes, the [b]Effective Range[/b] stat for [b]battle rifles[/b] now has less impact on a module’s score. Meaning modules that [i]sacrifice[/i] Effective Range are now a bit more expensive and those that [i]improve[/i] Effective Range are a bit cheaper.
	[*]All [b]short battle rifle barrels[/b] have been made a bit cheaper, except for [b]Short - Muzzle Brake[/b].
[list]
	[*][b]Short - Muzzle Brake has instead been given some better stats for handling spread and recoil during automatic fire.[/b]
[/list]
	[*][b]SLR Wolfshead now uses a Long - Standard barrel (instead of a Medium - Standard barrel).[/b]
	[*]The [b]headshot [/b]multipliers from [b]sniper rifles[/b] have been reduced. [b]Physical [/b]sniper rifles now have a headshot multiplier of 2.0 (down from 2.5) and [b]energy[/b] sniper rifles have a headshot multiplier of 1.6 (down from 2.0).
	[*]To compensate for their lowered headshot multipliers (which is a change primarily aimed at [b]heavy[/b] snipers), some of the base damage values of [b]sniper rifles[/b] have gone up.
[list]
	[*][b]Light and energy snipers now have a base damage of 60 (up from 50).[/b]
	[*][b]Heavy snipers now have a base damage of 82.5 (up from 80.55). Heavy snipers have also been made a bit cheaper to compensate for a relatively smaller increase in damage than before.[/b]
[/list]
	[*][b]Energy sniper rifles now have a 30% bullet velocity bonus (up from 20%).[/b]
	[*]The [b]Energy - Super-Heat[/b] sniper rifle ammo now has a 25% damage bonus (down from 35%) but is also a bit cheaper to equip.
	[*]The [b]Energy - Field-Breach[/b] sniper rifle ammo now has a 15% damage bonus (down from 25%) but is also a bit cheaper to equip.
	[*][b]Cluster sniper rifles are now cheaper to equip.[/b]
	[*]In light of the changes to sniper rifles, some weapons have had some module adjustments:
[list]
	[*][b]Tyr's Hand now uses the 'Flight Stabilizer' trigger, so it has faster bullets and is more effective over distance.[/b]
	[*][b]Cluster-Strike[/b] now uses the 'Acid Burst' trigger, so its cluster bombs do a bit more damage.
	[*][b]Devastator[/b] now uses the 'Core-Splitter' mag, which gives it its lost cluster bomb back.
[/list]
	[*]The [b]Cluster - Shock-Bomb[/b] sniper rifle ammo now slows enemies by 40% with their cluster bombs (up from 25%).
	[*]The [b]Heavy - Tri-Shot[/b] sniper rifle ammo now has a tighter spread (equal to the Light - Tri-Shot ammo’s spread).
	[*]All sniper rifle [b]cluster magazines[/b] are now slightly faster to reload, except for the Compact Injector.
	[*]The [b]Volt Flux [/b]sniper rifle magazine now deals 10% of the damage to deathbringer passengers (still 25% against passengers of other vehicles).
	[*]The [b]base damage[/b] of [b]plasma rifles[/b] is now 19 (up from 17).
[list]
	[*][b]All Surge plasma rifle ammo have received a damage [i]penalty[/i] to counteract this increase, so their damage should be mostly unaffected.[/b]
[/list]
	[*]The base [b]bullet velocity[/b] for [b]plasma rifles [/b]is now 500 m/s (up from 400).
[list]
	[*]Again, all [b]Surge[/b] plasma rifle ammo have received a bullet velocity [i]penalty[/i] to counteract this change, and will thus be unaffected.
[/list]
	[*]The values of [b]Close [/b]and [b]Long Range Bonuses[/b] for [b]plasma rifles[/b] have been adjusted. So many modules that adjust these stats will have had their cost adjusted (cheaper or more expensive when equipped). 
	[*]The [b]Quick Charge[/b] plasma rifle ammo has been renamed to [b]Fast Charge[/b] (to avoid confusion with the trigger) and had its long range damage penalty [i]removed[/i].
	[*]The [b]Flux Energy[/b] plasma rifle ammo now increases damage by 36% (up from 28.33%) and has had its long range damage penalty [i]removed[/i].
	[*]The [b]Condensed Energy[/b] plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 36% (up from 28.33%).
	[*]The [b]Supercharger [/b]plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 53.5% (up from 41.67%).
	[*]The [b]Unstable Release[/b] plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 33% (up from 26.67%) and is also a bit cheaper.
	[*]The [b]Shield Burster[/b] plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 24.33% (up from 18.33%).
	[*]The [b]Toxic I[/b] plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 4% (up from 3.33%) and its cloud does 12 damage per tick (up from 10).
	[*]The [b]Toxic II[/b] plasma rifle [b]ammo [/b]now increases damage by 8% (down from 8.33%) and its cloud does 17.5 damage per tick (up from 15).
	[*]The[b] Pulser Mk I[/b] plasma rifle trigger now increases damage by 8.5% (up from 8%).
	[*]The [b]Pulser Mk II[/b] plasma rifle trigger now increases damage by 15% (up from 14%).
	[*]The [b]Auto - Quick Charge[/b] plasma rifle trigger is now more expensive.
	[*]The damage reduction to shields from the [b]Standard - Shield Enforcer[/b] [b]plasma rifle magazine[/b] is now 25% (up from 15%).
	[*][b]Hailstorm now uses a 3x Holo Marksman sight instead of a 1.5x Holo Brawler.[/b]
	[*]Some of the weapons you can get from earthtree scraps have had new paint jobs applied to them.
	[*]The [b]Gyro-Bore[/b] sniper rifle barrel has been given a new appearance.
	[*]The [b]Plasma Array[/b] sniper rifle barrel has been given a new appearance.
[/list]
[h2]Movement[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The [b]movement speed bonus[/b] when wielding a [b]pistol [/b]or [b]beam gloves[/b] has been increased to 15% (up from 5%). This does not affect movement in the lobby, which remains at a +5% bonus.
	[*]Item based movement speed bonuses no longer apply to [b]Biocore carriers[/b], but they also no longer receive a flat movement speed [i]penalty[/i] for carrying the Biocore.
[/list]
[h2]Perks & Abilities[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The [b]Automatic Ramp-Up [/b]perk now caps out at a 10% bonus (as opposed to growing indefinitely).
	[*]The [b]Metal Melter[/b] perk now deals 5% of the damage to deathbringer passengers (still 10% against passengers of other vehicles).
[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The turret vehicle now goes a bit faster and does more ramming damage.
	[*]The cluster cannon in the [b]deathbringer[/b] is now affected by the same immunity system that cluster sniper rifles use: if a player is hit by a cluster bomb from the cannon, they can’t take damage from other cluster bombs for 0.5 seconds. This should make the cannon a bit less devastating when fired into tight spaces.
[/list]
[h2]Lobby[/h2]
[list]
	[*]When logging in to a lobby, we will now place you in the same lobby as your friends (if there currently are any in a lobby and there is space).
	[*]A new TV screen showing the current standings of the Top Dog event has been added to the lobby.
[/list]
[h2]Customization[/h2]
[list]
	[*]New facial hair options have been added to the character customizer.
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The mission progress screen after a match should now display which rewards you will get when completing the mission.
	[*]Friend codes will no longer be visible when in Streamer Mode.
	[*]The team information while getting ready for a match has been rejigged a bit in order to be more flexible with different team sizes.
	[*]The matchmaking screen has received a visual overhaul.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Using Escape to exit the matchmaking menu while in a party should now also unready you.
	[*]The player controlled gorlizard will now have a full health bar when it’s on full health. It appeared as partially empty previously due to lowering its max health during the playtest. Its max health [b]remains [/b]at the lowered state, just now has a health bar to match.
	[*]The 1k Bomber mission should now correctly say that you can also [i]heal [/i]with energy bombers in order to complete the mission.
	[*]Fixed a few typos and formatting errors in vendor dialogue in the lobby.
	[*]The ‘hide and seek’ pistol should now have sound.
	[*]The ‘[b]the Gorlizard[/b]’[b] [/b]and ‘[b]Deathbringer[/b]’[b] [/b]titles should now be awarded appropriately from the Puppet Master IV and Bringer of Death IV achievements.
	[*]The ‘[b]Seeker[/b]’ title should now be awarded appropriately from the Collector achievement, as opposed to the Plaything achievements. Those who got it from Plaything get to keep it.
	[*]The ‘Forest Power’ event should now be able to show up on the event screen at the start of a match.
	[*]Corrected the icon for the Puppet Master achievement.
	[*]If a teammate collects your weapon from the Weapon Replicator while you are disconnected, you should now still have it added to your unlocked weapons when you reconnect.
	[*]The game log message should now appear correctly if an enemy steals one of your weapons from the weapon replicator.
	[*]Healing missions should now also update when you repair shields.
	[*]You should now be able to properly select the sixth consumable in the UI if you’re using the [b]Extra Space[/b] perk.
	[*]The interact message from possession the gorlizard should no longer get stuck on screen after you’ve taken control of the gorlizard.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Beta Patch Notes
notes.notes:
It's been approximately 71 days since our open beta in August. We've made significant changes to ASCENDANT that we believe you will enjoy. Please take a look at what to expect during our week long Steam Next Fest Beta.

If you require any technical assistance, the best place for support is in our games community discord. You can join here if you haven't yet! https://discord.gg/7jf6336X 

[h2]Events[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The likelihood that multiple ‘map wide events’ are active at the same time has been increased.
[list]
	[*]For those unfamiliar with this term: ‘map wide events’ is how we refer to events that are automatically active and automatically affect the wider map in some way. For example, lightning strikes, locked main corridor entrances, central surveillance drones, etc.
[/list]
	[*]A new event has been added: [b]Fire Sale[/b].
[list]
	[*]For a brief period during the match, [i]everything [/i]in all shops around the map will be [b]completely free[/b].
	[*]You will be made aware of if Fire Sale will be on at some point during the match in the event overview at the start.
	[*]There will be a 1-minute warning before Fire Sale turns on, and it stays active for 3 minutes.
[/list]
	[*]Another map wide event has been added: [b]Forest Power Plants[/b].
[list]
	[*]When active, there will be special plants dotted around the trees and cave walls in the wilderness. You can destroy them by shooting at them. When destroyed, they drop power and some potential other goodies.
	[*]The plants come in a few different rarities, fairly distributed between spawning locations. The rarer plants (obviously) drop better things.
[/list]
	[*]A new match modifier (not quite an event in its own right) has been added: [b]event overload[/b]. When active, loads more events than usual will be on in the match.
	[*]The [b]Boss Summoner[/b] event has had an uplift and been moved slightly. Chances are you never even saw it before, which was part of the problem.
[list]
	[*]It can appear in two locations in the wilderness: in the caves to the waste, on top of one of the buildings between the forest and swamp to the east.
	[*]It’s now dressed up as a small camp with a console and a scanner drone. It still costs 200 power to activate. After activating it, the drone will lead the way to where the boss will appear.
[/list]
	[*]The [b]Upgrade Uplinks[/b] have received a face lift and now give out more information as to what they’re doing.
[list]
	[*]They are still large satellite dish looking things on top of a couple of buildings in the shade, but now larger than before.
	[*]If the event is not active, the device isn’t present at all.
	[*]When under your team’s control, the display will also tell you which [b]team upgrade[/b] it is funneling power into.
[/list]
	[*]It wouldn’t be an update without some changes to the [b]Gorlizard Control[/b] event:
[list]
	[*]When the gorlizard is possessed, a loud roar can be heard, to let you know what’s coming.
	[*]The [b]Roar[/b] ability sound has also been made louder.
	[*]When the gorlizard uses any of its [b]abilities[/b] (Roar, Leap, or Heal), it will also leave a temporary marker on the map, to give you a rough idea of where it might be.
[/list]
	[*]The [b]Deathbringer[/b] has received a few clarity updates:
[list]
	[*]When shot, a small health gauge will appear next to your crosshair (similar to that of the player controlled gorlizard) to give you a clearer idea of how much health it has.
	[*]While disabled, it will now show a ‘repairing’ icon to more clearly indicate that it has been disabled (in case the smoke and fire is obscured by [i]other[/i] smoke and fire).
[/list]
	[*]The uplift to the [b]Weapon Replicator[/b] event that was mentioned in the last patch notes should now be in [i]for real[/i].
[list]
	[*]It should now be much clearer when the event is active, when it is printing weapons, and when it has weapons ready and waiting.
[/list]
	[*]The screens on the [b]Extraction Uplinks[/b] (big pylons in the wilderness) have been remade to be easier to read.
[/list]
[h2]Match Rules[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Whether you won or lost a match is now called out immediately when a match ends, instead of having to wait for the celebration screen to find out.
[/list]
[h2]Weapons & Consumables[/h2]
[list]
	[*]How [b]Weapon Unlocks[/b] work has undergone some changes.
[list]
	[*]Like before, on certain level milestones, you will be given the option to unlock a new weapon. This means that you will get access to all vendors associated with said weapon and can access it in the [b]Weapon Customizer[/b].
	[*]Now, in addition to the above, each new weapon will give you [b]more modules[/b] to go along with it, along with a [b]weapon specific perk[/b].
	[*]Additionally, to save you some hassle, a new custom gun using your new modules will be automatically added to your list of custom weapons of that type and, if there is space, also added to your [b]loadout[/b].
	[*]Any players who have already unlocked weapons have been retroactively awarded the modules and perk.
[/list]
	[*]The damage reducing effect from the [b]Berzerk Boost[/b] plant now lasts 20 seconds (up from 10).
	[*]Different [b]beam gloves[/b] and [b]energy bombers [/b]you can buy or find in a match should now have some different appearances to make them easier to tell apart.
	[*][b]More weapon modules have received bespoke appearances.[/b]
	[*][b]Battle rifle audio has had some minor tweaks.[/b]
[*][b]The hyper cannon now reloads automatically on default reload settings (you no longer need to manually initiate it).[/b]
[*][b]Hit marks should now appear when you shoot shield repair domes, healing domes, and lightning rods.[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Movement[/h2]
[list]
	[*]You can now immediately climb after using a wind vortex or pulse bomb into a wall.
[*]The amount of time you get slowed by after getting shot has been slightly increased. You are now slowed by 20% for 0.5 seconds, and it then dissipates over the 0.5 seconds after that. This effect still can’t occur more often than every 2 seconds.
[/list]
[h2]Abilities & Perks[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The cooldown of the [b]Thundercall: Sequence[/b] ability has been reduced to 45 seconds (down from 60).
	[*]The cooldown of the [b]Thundercall: Rapid[/b] ability has been reduced to 20 seconds (down from 25) and its activation time has been reduced to 0.5 seconds (down from 1).
	[*]The [b]Bunker Dome: Defence[/b] ability now has a 50-second cooldown (down from 90) but the duration has also been reduced to 35 seconds (down from 60). The cost has also been reduced to [b]1,000 Upgrade Credits[/b].
	[*]A new variant of the [b]Bunker Dome [/b]ability has been added: [b]Bunker Dome: Assault[/b].
[list]
	[*]Like its sibling, it also projects a protective dome around you when activated. This dome lasts for [b]25 seconds[/b] but all allies inside of the dome (including yourself) also deal [b]20% more damage[/b].
	[*]It can be unlocked from [b]Marley[/b].
[/list]
	[*]The [b]Cheat Death[/b] perk now has a 20-second cooldown.
	[*]The [b]Ammo Specialist[/b] perk now also allows the user to carry 50 extra energy ammo.
	[*]The [b]Resilience[/b] perk now also reduces damage you receive by 50% while downed and holding a Biocore.
	[*]The [b]Toxic Transfusion[/b] perk has been nerfed a bit, and the heal now has a 1.5 second cooldown (up from 1 second).
	[*]The bonus damage from the [b]Cluster Splitter[/b] perk has been increased to 40% (from 20%).
[/list]
[h2]Vehicles[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The three-seater vehicle (the one with a machine gun up top) has been given a new look.
	[*]You can now be awarded with different[b] vehicle skins[/b] that you can apply to your quad.
[/list]
[h2]Environment[/h2]
[list]
	[*]A lot of new plants have been added to the wilderness.
	[*]Some less obvious plant swaps have also taken place in order to improve performance.
	[*]The ladder going from the cave into the exec quarter no longer has a hatch door, making it quicker and easier to get up and down.
	[*]A lot of lighting around the map has been updated.
[/list]
[h2]Lobby[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Halloween has arrived in the lobby! Not that anyone can remember what it is, but it [i]feels right[/i].
	[*]A number of vendors have received more chat options.
[list]
	[*]Some can provide you with useful gameplay tips, or you can chat to them for some more lore insight or just to get to know them better.
	[*]More will come in future updates.
[/list]
	[*]The pub in the lobby has been renamed to [b]The Side Quest[/b]. Gone with the Saucy Snail is also the strangely chested cattermaw. You will be missed (or, more likely, not).
[*]The gun sounds from the firing ranges should be a bit quieter.
[/list]
[h2]Customization[/h2]
[list]
	[*]New players can now choose between different premade appearances instead of being given one at random.
	[*]A new [b]beard [/b]style has been added. Hell yeah.
	[*]Some new [b]eye colors[/b] have been added.
	[*]Face wear should now get hidden while you are applying face customizations.
	[*]More different kinds of [b]underwear [/b]have been added.
	[*]You can now be rewarded with [b]charms [/b]that can be equipped to your [b]weapons[/b].
[*]You can now be rewarded with weapon skins that can be used to override the appearance of certain weapons.This only applies to weapons that can’t be built with modules (e.g. pistols and hyper weapons).
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
	[*]The accolade and results screens at the end of a match have been redesigned slightly.
[list]
	[*]The result screen should now make it clearer where your XP and Credit rewards are coming from.
[/list]
	[*]The chat window will now stay open for longer after a new message has been sent or received.
	[*]The ‘select your free flag decals’ interface now has a search field.
	[*]You can now toggle off the health and shield bar numbers in the settings menu.
	[*]Player stats that are given as ‘time spent’ should now display minutes and seconds instead of [i]just[/i] seconds.
	[*]Various icons for customization items and consumables have been replaced with updated versions.
[*]Various UI effects and dressing components have been given a face lift.
[/list]
[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list]
	[*]More improvements to [b]performance[/b].
	[*]The [b]resurrection point[/b] ping now lasts longer.
	[*]Player [b]outlines [/b]have been reworked to be clearer at distance and make it easier to distinguish if a highlighted player is behind or in front of obstacles.
	[*]All projectile tracers have been completely reworked to be a bit clearer and also more performant.
	[*]Fire can now damage doors.
	[*]Some previously silent interactions now have sound effects. Notably, this includes a sound effect for stealing Biocores from a base. So you should now be able to hear if an enemy player is trying to sneak it away.
	[*]Made some changes to how ‘shaders are being compiled’ is messaged to be a bit less jarring.
	[*]Reworked how fire looks on players and creatures when they are on fire. It should now look less like intermittent explosions.
	[*]More [b]achievements[/b] have been added.
	[*]More [b]achievements[/b] have been given cosmetic rewards. If you have already completed such an achievement, you will automatically be given the reward.
	[*]Your current state in game will now be shown in your Steam friends list.
	[*]Updated various healing effects that were yellow to instead be green.
[*]Leaderboard support has been added. For the time being, they are only used by the Top Dog event, but will be expanded to include more leaderboards with a future update.
[*]You can now block voice chat in the lobby without also having to block team chat. Lobby voice chat block defaults to ON, so you’ll need to unblock it under Audio Options.
[*]Rare dyes should now be a bit more likely to get from rare mystery bags.
[*]You can now link your Twitch account to the game, in order to participate in Twitch drop events.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue where a bad connection could lead to bullets not being allowed to register hits in close range combat.
	[*]The [b]Factory Printer[/b] event buttons should no longer claim to be ‘ready’ when the event is offline.
[list]
	[*]They should also be easier to interact with when the event [i]is [/i]active.
[/list]
[list]
	[*]Various collision fixes around the map, making collisions smoother and easier to traverse.
[*]Some of these fixes will also have removed instances where you would end up briefly teleporting up and down at the end of a climb (e.g. on the cylindrical shape on top of the thermal transfer building).
[/list]
	[*]Fixed an issue where you couldn’t uncrouch if you were holding a Biocore and crouched inside a forward camp.
	[*]More fixes to IK interactions with various surfaces to stop players and NPCs clipping through them onto whatever was beneath.
	[*]Your arms should no longer be floating while wielding beam gloves in an ultra wide resolution.
	[*]The hyper cannon icon has been updated to match its new appearance.
	[*]Fixed some issues where the earthtree drop pods would reinitialise some effects if you disconnected and reconnected.
	[*]The [b]Long-Range Reinforcer[/b] and [b]Headhunter[/b] perks should be working as intended again.
	[*]The [b]Shield Upgrader[/b] perk can now upgrade tier 3 shields to tier 4 again.
	[*]The [b]Metal Melter[/b] perk’s bonus damage to vehicles should now be working properly.
	[*][b]Recharger modules should once again be able to generate ammo even while not equipped.[/b]
	[*]Made some fixes to various hairstyles to make them fit different head shapes a bit better.
	[*]Burrower pings should have their voice callouts back.
	[*]The pick-ups for the [b]Hyper Cannon[/b], [b]Hyper Rifle[/b], [b]Flamethrower[/b], [b]Surge Beam[/b], and [b]X3 Incendiary[/b] pistol are no longer just red.
	[*]Level up effects should no longer be getting stuck in the lobby.
	[*]The [b]Gorlizard Control[/b] event now uses the correct icon.
	[*]The [b]Shop Uplink[/b] should no longer give out power [i]twice[/i] each cycle.
	[*][b]Banner parts that come from achievements should now tell you which achievements they come from, if you haven’t unlocked them yet.[/b]
	[*]Fixed an issue where the scope shader wouldn’t go away properly if you Alt-tabbed out of the game while in scope mode.
	[*]The ‘wall of fame’ display in the bar should now display all names correctly.
	[*]You should no longer be able to make it into the water treatment room through the large pipe if the area is not available in a match.
	[*]The ‘contesting’ overlay should now go away if you contest a Biocore as a [b]gorlizard[/b] and then get killed and sent back to your regular, old human body.
	[*]Fixed various overlapping elements in the HUD.
	[*]Fixed an issue where cattermaw could get stuck in weird places.
	[*][b]Tracker[/b] modules should no longer highlight teammates.
	[*]Training dummies can now contest Biocores in the [b]deathbringer[/b].
	[*]Revives will now get interrupted if you get knocked away mid-revive.
	[*]Fixed a few dialogue typos.
	[*]The [b]spotlight banners[/b] around the lobby should now be better at displaying players who come back from a match with impressive stats.
	[*]Fixed an issue where, occasionally, the ‘blur’ effect applied to the seeker in ‘hide and seek’ wouldn’t go away when the game started.
[*]The Discount team upgrade should no longer require you to have the full cost power amount before spending the discounted amount.
[*]Fixed an issue where the firing VFX could sometimes get stuck to an automatic weapon.
[*]Traps can now be triggered by training dummies.
[*]Fixed some doors that couldn’t be closed (they would just automatically reopen half way through the closing sequence, due to thinking something was in the way).
[*]EMP grenades (and the EMP event) should now work properly with doors that are in the process of opening or closing.
[*]Training dummies should now be appearing on the toxic gas and blast door maps.
[*]When you buy a custom weapon during a match, only that weapon will be claimed to be ‘purchased’ on the little screens in the shop. Previously, if you had multiple custom weapons, they would all think they had been purchased.
[*]When healing yourself, you should no longer see hit indicators as if you hit an enemy.

notes.title: Closed Tech Test: September 14 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've been grinding away at ASCENDANT ever since we received player feedback back in our August open beta, and we're excited to see what you think during this technical test.

After the event please complete our feedback form to let us know what you think. The more feedback we receive, the better and faster we can implement meaningful changes you want in the next event you play in. <3

If you require any technical assistance, the best place for support is in our games community discord. You can join here if you haven't yet! https://discord.gg/7jf6336X 

[h1]Performance[/h1]
We heard you loud and clear, and we've made significant changes under the hood to meet your expectations. Performance improvements have been made in a ton of different areas. Like…a lot of things have been optimized. Loads. Many. Also [b]Reflex Mode[/b] support has been added to the graphical settings.

[h1]Events[/h1]
[list]
[*]The poor [b]Gorlizard Control[/b] just keeps on getting nerfed. These changes are primarily focused at reducing its survival and ability to play safely.
[list]
[*] Its Heal ability cooldown is now 120 seconds (up from 40).
[*] Its Leap ability cooldown is now 25 seconds (up from 20).
[*] The damage from its spit has been reduced by 20%.
[/list]
[*][b]Wind Vortices[/b] are now present in every match. Instead of just a binary ‘on or off’, different combinations of vortices will instead be active from match to match.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Earthtree Scraps[/b] (the pods that can fall out of the earthtree) have undergone a lot of changes.
[list]
[*] They now come in two forms: regular scraps and golden scraps.
[*] Regular scraps always contain a tier 3 shield and power.
[*] The golden scraps now always contain a tier 4 shield or a team life, along with a special ‘beyond rare’ powered weapon. There are six possible weapons that can be acquired from the golden pods:
[list]
[*] [b]T3 Viper[/b] - A semi-automatic spore rifle that deals triple damage with the last shot of its magazine.
[*] [b]CFR Flamespitter[/b] - A pyro plasma rifle with a lot of self heal, and the fire reduces the damage output of any victims.
[*] [b]HPR-200 Shellshock[/b] - A heavy sniper rifle with shield piercing rounds.
[*] [b]BV7 Shield Breaker[/b] - A shotgun that deals particularly high damage to shields and comes with self healing and shield repairing capabilities.
[*] [b]Grim Reaper[/b] - Dual purpose beam gloves tuned for both damage and healing, along with life steal.
[*] [b]SF-10 Annihilator[/b] - A high powered energy bomber that deals bonus damage to shields with fully loaded specials and slightly repairs your shield when the last round of the magazine is fired.
[/list]
[*] Additionally, there is a new [b]match modifier[/b] that can trigger a rain of [b]rare earthtree scraps[/b] in the early minutes of the match. Loads of powerful shields and weapons to fight over!
[/list]
[*] The base chance of [b]lightning strikes[/b] to spawn the [b]Lightning Rod[/b] consumable has been increased from 5% to 15% (this chance still grows the more times lightning strikes close to any given team have not spawned a rod).
[*] The [b]Shop Uplink[/b] event has been simplified and made more powerful. Instead of trickling out 200 power over time (with recharge times between each lots of 200) to whichever team controls one, [b]250 power[/b] is now given out immediately after it has been charged.
[list]
[*] The effect still cycles, so several lots of 250 power will be given out across a match to whichever team controls it at the time.
[/list]
[*] An automatic [b]Surveillance Drone[/b] event has been added. When active, surveillance drones will spawn from the earthtree and patrol the shade, looking for threats. Any player they spot becomes highlighted to all enemy teams.
[list]
[*] If destroyed, the surveillance drone drops one of the following: power, a frag grenade, or an HE grenade.
[/list]
[*] As we are getting more of them, automatic map wide events are now more common.
[*] The [b]Boss Summoner[/b] event now highlights the boss it has spawned to your team for 1 minute.
[list]
[*] This is just a little quality-of-life improvement for now; some bigger improvements to this event are coming in the next update.
[/list]
[*] The [b]Weapon Replicator[/b] event has undergone a bit of a visual overhaul and should now be much more obvious when active and when working on weapons.[/list]
[h1]Match Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mission specific world pick-ups and consoles now give score to your team.
[*] The match no longer abruptly ends when the final biocore is secured. This bit is still awaiting some additional polish, but it now announces that it was secured before the match results appear.
[*] In matches with a team size of 2 or less, and with 5 or fewer teams, all players will be given an additional life.
[/list]
[h1]Weapons & Consumables[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Shotgun magazines[/b] have undergone some balancing changes in regards to their cost; i.e. by how much shotgun power costs vary when you equip different magazines.
[list]
[*] For [b]light[/b] and [b]energy[/b] magazines, any magazines with a ‘larger than default’ capacity have had their costs increased across the board.
[*] For [b]heavy[/b] magazines, the costs of ‘smaller than default’ magazines are now slightly higher than they used to be.
[/list]
[*] [b]Shotgun blast pattern[/b] modules have also had their relative costs reviewed.
[list]
[*] The biggest changes have been done to the [b]X [/b]and [b]T [/b]spreads, with X getting more expensive and T getting a lot cheaper.
[/list]
[*] [b]Shotgun melee bonuses[/b] are now more expensive. I.e., shotgun modules that increase melee damage now cost more and shotguns modules that reduce melee damage are now cheaper.
[*] A side effect of the changes to [b]shotgun modules[/b] is that the following shotguns have had various modules swapped out:
[list]
[*] Rigor Mortis (less damage and wider spread, but faster reloads)
[*] Last Horizon (slower reload but slightly more damage over distance)
[*] Oathkeeper’s Verdict (less damage and slightly slower reloads)
[*] Justicar (this one has undergone a much larger rework, focusing on fire rate over larger individual hits, and now uses the X blast pattern instead of the hexagonal)
[/list]
[*] [b]Sniper rifle energy ammo[/b] have had their bullet velocities increased by 20%.
[list]
[*] This does not apply to cluster ammo, but their bullet velocity penalties have been reduced from -12% to -10%.
[/list]
[*] Most weapons you can acquire in a match have received new paint jobs. Beam gloves and energy bombers are still waiting for theirs.
[*] The [b]hyper cannon[/b] has been given a new appearance.
[*] Some more modules have received custom appearances.
[list]
[*] Most notably is perhaps that the [b]4x Scope[/b] for the [b]battle rifle[/b] is now actually a scope and not a holo sight.
[/list]
[*] In order to improve response times when hitting a target, the client will now predict hits and show the ‘hit confirm’ indicator before the server has verified it.
[list]
[*] In general, this should make combat feel much more responsive. However, there may be some situations where the server can deny such a hit (e.g. if you happen to have had poorly timed packet loss or playing on an unstable connection), but this should be incredibly rare for most people.
[*] How much damage was done still won’t show up until the server has returned it, so this delay will still depend on your ping time.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Movement & Animations[/h1]
[list]
[*] There is now an animation playing for when you interact with objects around the map. This animation is fully interruptible so will never prevent you from taking other actions.
[*] The crouched weapon stance now also applies to the pistol.
[/list]
[h1]Abilities[/h1]
[list]
[*] The [b]Rocket Jump[/b] ability now launches you less far if you’re already high in the air when triggering it.
[/list]
[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
[list]
[*] The vehicle machine gun turret now has faster projectiles (900 m/s, up from 600 m/s) and tighter spread.
[*] You can now press Q to swap weapons while in a vehicle. The default button to change seats while in a vehicle has been changed to Z.
[*] Quad bike steering has been made a bit more nimble.
[/list]
[h1]Creatures[/h1]
[list]
[*] Black-red cattermaw will now drop a rare weapon if they don’t drop a shield (meaning you will always get some high tier equipment from them).
[*] Black-red and blue cattermaw are now a bit more aggressive and also use their ranged attack more often.
[*] Cattermaw projectiles now move faster and deal more damage.
[*] Destroying the neck gland on a cattermaw now deals bonus damage to it (as well as disabling the ranged attack).
[*] The entirety of a cattermaw’s shell is now destroyed in one go, instead of the two sides being independently destroyed. This should make it easier to take advantage of their weak spot underneath the shell.
[*] Regular gorlizard weapon drops are now uncommon instead of common.
[*] Burrowers always spawn in their unburrowed state, and won’t burrow until after they’ve been in combat.
[*] The health values of the burrower armor plates on arms and legs have been reduced.
[/list]
[h1]Environment[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are now many more respawn points spread around the centre of the map, and more of them will be active in each match.
[list]
[*] Remember that these respawn points can only be held by one team at a time, so enemies can steal them from you (or vice versa!).
[/list]
[*] The [b]Shop Uplink[/b] consoles have had their areas slightly reworked to make them easier to spot.
[list]
[*] For reference, one can occasionally be found in the admin offices on the surface, and one in ‘deep storage’ just behind the warehouse down in the vaults.
[/list]
[*] More assets around the map have had their collisions reworked to improve traversal over and around them.
[*] The plants across the fields have been reworked to provide more consistent soft cover.
[*] The earthtree has been replaced with a new model.
[/list]
[h1]Lobby[/h1]
[list]
[*] The lobby has received more visual upgrades.
[*] New celebratory effects play when a particularly outstanding player returns from a match and ends up on the MVP podium.
[*] Some characters around the lobby have had some outfit and animation uplifts.
[*] A bunch of new hiding spots for the ‘Hide and Seek’ activity have been added.
[*] ‘ALL STAR’ displays have been added to the lobby, showing off creators who have met the requirements for the ‘wall of fame’.
[/list]
[h1]Customization[/h1]
[list]
[*] New underwear has been added.
[*] Some new hair styles can now be unlocked from Hugo.
[*] Celeste and Max have some new clothing items for sale.
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] More consumables have had their icons reworked.
[*] ‘Escape’ can now more consistently be used as a shortcut to close menus.
[*] The respawn screen now has named buttons to go with each of the unlocked points.
[*] Mission iconography has been updated to be more consistent and clearer.
[*] The customization UI has been updated to no longer be split up across three different screens.
[*] Health and shield values are now also shown as numbers next to the bars.
[*] The game log (i.e. the section where things like kills and team updates go) have had an update to make the entries stand out a bit more.
[*] The inventory screen has had some updates to be easier to understand at a quick glance.
[*] The ‘Winners’ screen have had some visual updates.
[*] Various buttons around the project have been updated to feel more responsive when hovered, along with some general visual uplifts.
[*] Some of the fanfare effects that appear when you, say, increase reputation have had an uplift.
[/list]
[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] The smoke that comes out of a sabotaged base vehicle is now more clear and lingers for longer.
[*] Chip, the shop tutorial guy, now has an animation for when he’s sitting down and talking, so that it’s more obvious what’s going on.
[*] The tutorial video that plays in the cryo pod has been made a bit smaller so that players in tighter FoVs can take it in without having to turn.
[*] A greater variety of original music tracks have been added for those playing in ‘streamer mode’.
[*] Pinging a biocore will now also reveal it to your team on the map.
[*] The [b]power[/b] pick-ups have a new model and there is now a visual difference between different quantities of power.
[*] The hit box for [b]heads[/b] has been made a bit bigger in order to be more forgiving when trying to land headshots.
[*] You must now [b]deposit power[/b] into shops before you can spend it.
[*] Made pick-up hit boxes for a variety of items larger; in particular for weapons.
[*] You can now be invited to a party (and play a real match) even without having done the tutorial. Playing a match with friends in this way will also advance the ‘do the tutorial’ mission so you can carry on with progression.
[list]
[*] You can still play the tutorial at any point via the matchmaking menu.
[/list]
[*] The interaction area on the base vehicle sabotage point has been made bigger so it’s easier to interact with (e.g. to repair or use a hacking device to sabotage it).
[*] The intro video to the game mode tutorial has been removed. The information it presents is covered elsewhere anyway, so this should get you into the action a bit quicker.
[*] Different pick-ups now come with different pick-ups sounds (instead of a single generic one).
[*] More voice lines for picking up weapons have been added.
[*] Speaker announcements in the vaults should now be louder and audible from further away.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A pretty big issue in regards to weapon tracers has finally been fixed:
[list]
[*] Up until now, all tracers have been visualized slightly in the past, meaning the visual of where your bullets are traveling is actually where they used to be and not where they currently are, which could lead to some misleading situations around whether your projectiles hit or not.
[/list]
[*] With this fix, weapon tracers are now accurately representing where your bullets are traveling in real time.
[*] However, as a heads up, this fix has introduced a different issue which is still being looked into: when bullets hit walls, tracers can occasionally be seen disappearing right before the wall instead of on it. This is not nearly as bad as the previous issue, though, so we decided to put this fix in anyway while we’re working out the final kinks.
[*] NPCs in the lobby now blink. No dried out eyeballs for Victor tonight.
[*] Fixed various issues to do with some parts of the UI using default values if you disconnect and reconnect.
[*] Accepting a duel while you are searching for a match should no longer cancel the search.
[*] Initiating a climb at high velocity should no longer maintain that velocity when the climb finishes (and should thus not launch you into the air at the apex of the climb).
[*] Fixed a variety of snapping issues when going between animations.
[*] Fixed various typos.
[*] Removed a stutter issue that could occur when using a wind vortex.
[*] Fixed the upgrade station interaction text to not always claim they are unavailable.
[*] Fixed a few issues with the text displayed by mission computer terminals.
[*] Boss Summoning stations should no longer show mission markers when the player is on a mission to use them if they aren’t active.
[*] Fixed an issue where gorlizards would sometimes go through doors.
[*] Fixed some issues with how different modules made use of player chosen dyes.
[*] Fixed some issues with creature health bars not always properly appearing.
[*] A lot of little gaps between assets have been closed up. Mainly for performance reasons, but in some cases these were also large enough to look through.
[*] DLSS settings should now apply and save properly.
[*] The screens surrounding the airstrike console should now also be off if the event is off.
[*] The panels around the central extraction event should now also be off if the event is off.
[*] Driving over a wind vortex should no longer cause your character to look as it gets pulled out of the vehicle.
[*] The warehouse lift could occasionally break based on how the map unlocked. It should now always function.
[*] The objective description for the ‘Running (for) a Gauntlet’ mission should now point out all the locations where energy cells can be located.
[*] Fullscreen mode should now default to native screen resolution.
[*] You should no longer be able to enter water treatment through the large pipe with pulse bombs if the area is sealed.
[/list]

[*]Sunday, October 8th from 4-8 pm ET
[/list]
If you haven't already, scroll down to the "Join Ascendant Playtest" section on our steam page and sign up for the action. Already signed up? You're good to go!

Downloads and updates will be available one hour before the play test starts.
See you out on the battlefield!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Lobby Activities[/h2]
You can now play ‘Hide and Seek’ or duel other players in the lobby! You also no longer need to find a secret button to take part in the Rocky Road time trial.
Note that you can still queue for matches while taking part in lobby activities!

[h3]Hide and Seek[/h3]
[list]
[*]Every hour, a game of hide and seek will begin in the lobby. To sign up, head over to the back of the Drunken Drone.
[*]If you don’t want to wait for a scheduled game, any player can also initiate a hide and seek match of their own, as long as it’s at least 10 minutes before the hour. To do so, simply head over to the console at the back of the Drunken Drone.
[*]After a short countdown, one participant will become the hunter and be given a gun. Their objective is simple: find the other contestants and shoot them to make them join your team!
[*]If all hiders are found within 5 minutes, the seekers win. Otherwise, the remaining hiders win.
[*]The way to differentiate a player taking part in Hide and Seek from one who is not is that participants will not display nameplates when you’re close to them.
[/list]
Known issues:
[list]
[*]If you’re the first hunter and find yourself unable to stop moving at the start of a match, simply bump into an obstacle and you should regain normal controls again.
[*]The hide and seek pistol is a bit poorly aligned, so will cover your crosshair when you ADS with it.
[*]The audio announcement for a new match starting is not working, so we rely on you to spread the word when you set up your own games!
[/list]
[h3]Duel Arena[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you walk up to another player and press ‘F’, you will be given an option to challenge them to a 1v1 duel.
[*]Once the challenge has been accepted, you will get to decide on what rules you want to have for the duel, and which weapons you want to use (along with a pistol).
[*]Then simply fight to the death!
[/list]
Known issues:
[list]
[*]The mouse cursor can go invisible when you appear on the rules interface. It is there, so you can still click buttons and it will reappear when you do. You can also Alt-Tab out of the window and click in again to regain the cursor.
[*]Sound effects may sometimes get stuck when a duel ends.
[*]Name plates will show up above your opponent’s head when you’re close.
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lighting and shadow settings have been adjusted to allow for better performance on older generation graphics cards when playing on lower settings, alongside many other performance optimisations. Note that we still have a fair way to go here, so all issues will not have been resolved yet.
[*]The collision around a lot of rocks throughout the forest has been updated to make the rocks smoother and easier to climb, move around, and run over.
[*]Text chat can now be fully disabled from settings.
[*]The matchmaking introduction video has been given a new cut to reduce its length and focus more on just explaining the core objectives of the game mode.
[*]Matchmaking will now take a bit longer to try to create more even matches before widening the search window to include everyone.
[*]The ‘while waiting’ pop-up in the lobby now also instructs players on how to use emotes.
[*]The screen percentage setting will no longer be changed by other settings when unlocked.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Friends on Steam will now show up more reliably the first time they enter the game.
[*]Players should no longer be appearing naked at the start of a game while their customisation pieces are still being loaded.
[*]The lobby now has a map that properly matches its layout.
[*]Sound effects in the tutorial should now be properly affected by your audio settings.
[*]Voice chat should no longer overlap introduction videos.
[*]Various crash issues have been resolved.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the thermal transfer roof to be particularly difficult to climb onto.
[*]Resolved an issue where a disconnected player would sometimes become invulnerable.
[/list]
